Decipher.com cardlists archive face for [[Nal Hutta]] (Jabba's Palace), '''rotated 180°''' from [[:File:JP-D-nalhutta-decipher-archive.gif]] so that the Dark Side text ("During your control phase, may search Reserve Deck, take one Bounty or Hutt Bounty into hand; reshuffle.") reads the right way up. The rotation is lossless: same pixels and palette, no rescaling, no other change.
